tex_content.html:
Lemma
[trajectories of a vector field: existence and local uniqueness]

1. ch3:2.2

Let $X$ be a $C^1$ vector field on a boundaryless manifold $M$ modelled on a complete normed space, and $p\in M$. Then there is a trajectory of $X$ through $p$ at $t=0$ (a curve $\gamma $ with $\gamma '=X(\gamma )$ defined near $0$), and any two trajectories of $X$ that agree at a time $t_0$ agree on a neighbourhood of $t_0$. (Picard--Lindelöf and Grönwall, transported to the manifold through a chart.)
